description: Quotes the Singapore property rules that apply to a buyer, exactly as published, with the authority, source link, effective date and the date each was last checked: additional buyer's stamp duty, buyer's stamp duty, financing limits and seller's stamp duty. It quotes and does not work out any duty or rate; read the figure from the quote. Seller's stamp duty depends on the purchase date, so supply purchase_date to get the right regime. Supply slug for an executive condominium launch to add the EC rules that apply to its site. A rule that is being re-checked is named without its quote. This is general information and not advice on a particular purchase; confirm with the agent.

profile.description: The buyer's status: sc (Singapore Citizen), spr (Singapore Permanent Resident), foreigner or entity

properties_owned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns: 0, 1 or 2 (2 means two or more)

purchase_date.description: Date the property was or will be bought, as YYYY-MM-DD. Chooses the seller's stamp duty regime.

slug.description: A launch slug. For an executive condominium, the reply adds the EC rules for that site.

name: rules_for_buyer
